_comment: This file is loaded with Godot's JSON.parse_string (see item_data.gd), which is STRICT JSON - it has no // or /* */ comments. Adding real comments will fail to parse and silently empty out treasure config. Use '_comment_<field>' sibling keys like the ones below instead - the loader only reads specific named keys, so extra '_'-prefixed keys are safely ignored.
_comment_items_per_tier: Guaranteed regular-kind (consumable/passive) items in every chest, indexed by CURRENT MAP TIER (index 0/1/2 = Tier 0/1/2). Rolled from the consumable+passive pool only - never artifacts. Tiers past index 2 use index 2 as their base, then infinite_mode.items_per_tier_increment below adds further growth.
_comment_artifacts_per_tier: Guaranteed artifact-kind items in every chest, same tier indexing as items_per_tier above. Rolled from the artifact pool only, so the player is never left with an all-regular-items chest once past Tier 0. Tiers past index 2 use index 2 as their base, then infinite_mode.artifacts_per_tier_increment below adds further growth.
_comment_luck_per_bonus_item_and_max: On top of items_per_tier above: every luck_per_bonus_item points of PlayerManager.get_luck() adds 1 extra regular item to the chest, capped at max_bonus_items.
_comment_luck_per_bonus_artifact_and_max: Same idea as luck_per_bonus_item/max_bonus_items above, but for artifact count - a separate (higher) luck cost per bonus artifact since artifacts are the more powerful reward. On top of artifacts_per_tier above.
_comment_luck_per_reroll_and_max: Every luck_per_reroll points of luck grants 1 extra independent rarity roll per loot slot (best of N kept), capped at max_rerolls - see ItemData._roll_best_rarity.

infinite_mode._comment_base_tier: Last map tier items_per_tier/artifacts_per_tier actually define (same convention as curses.json config.infinite_mode.base_tier). Infinite mode keeps incrementing the tier number forever past this point, so the increments/caps below keep chests scaling where the per-tier arrays above no longer do.
infinite_mode._comment_items_per_tier_increment_and_ma: Extra guaranteed regular items added per map tier ABOVE base_tier, clamped at max_items total (set max_items to -1 to remove the clamp) - this is the 'up to a point' cap so infinite runs don't hand out unlimited chest items.
infinite_mode._comment_artifacts_per_tier_increment_an: Same idea as items_per_tier_increment/max_items above, but for artifact count.

_example_infinite_mode_tier_4: Worked example at map tier 4 (2 tiers past base_tier=2): items = items_per_tier[index 2, since tier 4 is past the array's last index 2] = 15, plus (4-2)*items_per_tier_increment = extra guaranteed items, clamped at max_items. artifacts = artifacts_per_tier[index 2] = 2, plus (4-2)*artifacts_per_tier_increment = extra guaranteed artifacts, clamped at max_artifacts. Luck-based bonus regular items (luck_per_bonus_item/max_bonus_items) and bonus artifacts (luck_per_bonus_artifact/max_bonus_artifacts) both still apply ON TOP of these guaranteed counts.
_comment_rarity_weights_by_tier: Same CURRENT MAP TIER indexing as items_per_tier/artifacts_per_tier above (tiers past index 2 clamp to index 2 - see MapGenerator._configure_tier / ItemData.get_treasure_rarity_weights).
